additional_info.subject: Reported issue
additional_info.body: Customer reported on Friday that the door position sensor triggered again and that charging was not possible until Monday afternoon, when the customer presumably fixed the charger himself. Can you please check the logs during that time to confirm the observation & ideally tell if the door position sensor triggered without the door being open? Previously work was performed on the door sensor, so... would be good to know if an additional FS intervention is needed.

Thanks!

additional_info.subject: RE: Ticket 0394743 has been closed. Are you satisfied with our provided solution? CRM:02023000377
additional_info.body:
Dear Thomas,
I have reviewed the logs from December 8th to December 9th, within the specified timeframe. During my analysis, I observed that the logs indicate one or both doors were open when the DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4 was active in the error flags. As previously discussed, this issue may be attributed to the door not being calibrated. There was no error flags related to power converter errors.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vikas Khiladkar
